title: Multi-tier custom eggless cakes for Rosehill and Camellia weddings
summary:
A 200-guest wedding needs more than one tier. Rosehill and Camellia families ask us this every season — can an eggless cake still carry that scale? Yes. Multi-tier custom cakes are quoted individually, built for the guest count you actually have, not a fixed size chart.

Six base sizes, 15 flavours, any design. Buttercream, fondant, or ganache — each tier built to hold. 100% eggless, every layer, not just the top one.

48 hours minimum. For a multi-tier order, more notice means more precision. Order via WhatsApp: +61 425 697 725. We speak Hindi and Gujarati too.
keywords: can an eggless cake hold up as a multi-tier wedding cake
